gen-cabinet-grotesk-gf-padyakke-expanded: Sharp and sleek up top, then Padyakke Expanded One spreads its wide-mouthed letters out like knots on a slack rope. Cabinet Grotesk keeps its curves full.
gen-cabinet-grotesk-gf-stint-ultra-expan: Crisp, confident curves lead the way. Stint Ultra Expanded follows with serif letters floating apart, pipe-cleaner thin, so a long page drifts by slowly and spaciously.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Almendra Display never pinches a letter shut. Its ornate, tall-lowercase look sits against Noto Sans Tamil, whose terminals stop far from the stem, and that gap is the pair's real draw.
gen-comfortaa-fs-asap: Comfortaa draws a wide-open ring for its c, with neon-tube strokes and spacing stretched like an uncoiled spring. And Asap answers in a sturdier plain sans, its lowercase standing nearly as tall as the capitals.
gen-comfortaa-fs-epilogue: Friendly neon-tube curves up top, then Epilogue arrives with a tall-bodied lowercase, stubby ascender tips and a wire-like skeleton. Give the sans a size that lets those curves breathe.
gen-comfortaa-fs-merriweather-sans: That wide-open ring of a c is pure Comfortaa, drawn like neon tube and spaced like an uncoiled spring. Merriweather Sans brings tall, sturdy lowercase, so shrinking the heading would let the body overpower it.
gen-comfortaa-general-sans: Comfortaa's neon-tube strokes and ring-shaped c give it a friendly, stretched-out look. General Sans keeps a steady pen pressure with an x-height that fills the line, so paragraphs glide along smoothly.
gen-comfortaa-gf-science-gothic: Round, friendly and spaced like a loosened spring. Science Gothic sets its stroke ends far apart with no thick or thin parts, so a long passage feels like reading one letter at a time.
gen-comfortaa-gf-syncopate: Comfortaa's c is a wide-open ring, drawn like neon tube. If Syncopate were set large, its rope-ladder spacing and technical-pen steadiness would crowd the heading out.
gen-comfortaa-manrope: Friendly from the first letter, Comfortaa draws a ring-like c in neon-tube strokes with spacing like an uncoiled spring. Manrope backs it with bright, open curves and a pen line of one width.
